# Third-party libraries

- GSAP 3.13.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, copyright GreenSock. Original distributed copyright/license headers are retained. Standard license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ . Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.13.0
- Three.js 0.180.0, copyright three.js authors. MIT license is included at `three/LICENSE`. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.180.0

Files are pinned and served locally. Google Fonts stylesheet requests are optional external requests; system fonts remain available when they fail. No analytics, tracking pixels, or third-party form endpoint is configured.
